summary.text: Patrick Chludzinski is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly representing District 143, which he has represented since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a police officer by profession.

paragraphs.text: Chludzinski served in the U.S. Army.
He earned an associate degree in science humanities from Erie Community College and attended Buffalo State College.
His career experience includes working as a police officer.
